headline: With Switch 2, iPhone, and laptop tricks, the Sharge Disk Pro 2 is finally a worthy EDC
summary: The new Sharge Disk Pro 2 Ultra is a highly-rated portable SSD. It also functions as a 4K HDMI dock for versatile use. Compatible with Switch 2, iPhones, and laptops, making it an ideal everyday carry.

headline: Apple’s new AirTags are back down to their best price
summary: Apple AirTag four-packs are currently on sale for $89, a $10 discount. This price matches the all-time low for the bundle. Deals are available at Amazon, Target, and Costco for members.

headline: Google Earth's AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summary: Google launched an AI tool allowing users to edit Google Earth satellite images with text prompts. The feature enabled the creation of 'AI deepfakes' of real-world locations. Google quickly shut down the controversial tool after just one day of availability.

headline: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
summary: The NHTSA is investigating nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles. The probe concerns complaints about suspension failure that could lead to a loss of directional control. Affected models include 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2021-2023 Model Y.

headline: Everything Coming to Netflix in August 2026
summary: Netflix reveals its lineup of new content for August 2026. Featured titles include 'Chucky' and 'Fast and Furious'. Also arriving are Ricky Gervais as a cartoon cat and 'The Whisper Man'.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leak on Social Media Reportedly Seen by Millions Before Sony Took It Down
summary: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has reportedly suffered a significant leak. A high-quality bootleg version spread across social media platforms like X/Twitter. Sony swiftly intervened to take down the unauthorized content.

headline: Everything Coming to Disney+ in August
summary: Disney+ announces a 'stacked lineup' of new content for August. Offerings include titles from Star Wars, X-Men, Pokemon, and Disney Princesses. Surprisingly, new 'League of Legends' content is also slated for release.

headline: Amazon Is Having a Lord of the Rings T-Shirt Sale This Weekend
summary: Amazon is hosting a special sale this weekend. The promotion features a variety of Lord of the Rings T-shirts. Fans can find discounted apparel from the iconic franchise.

headline: Uefa has 'lost confidence' in Infantino's Fifa leadership
summary: Uefa has publicly declared its 'lost confidence' in Fifa President Gianni Infantino. European football's governing body criticizes Infantino's leadership. He is accused of failing to deliver on promises made a decade ago.

headline: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
summary: Spain has criticized the 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings. Italy temporarily suspended its Schengen arrangement with Spain in response. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the situation in Ceuta as 'shocking'.

headline: Sir John Curtice: The "Burnham bounce" is real but it's not massive
summary: Sir John Curtice confirms a 'Burnham bounce' in the governing party's poll ratings. The party's ratings have indeed improved recently. However, their lead over Reform remains narrow.

headline: Labour's Bev Craig elected Greater Manchester mayor, succeeding Andy Burnham
summary: Labour's Bev Craig has been elected as the new Greater Manchester mayor. She takes over the role from the long-serving Andy Burnham. Craig secured nearly double the votes of her Reform UK opponent, Sian Astley.
